answer: Require every agent to lock a decaying stake before earning, like timber that must season before it can bear weight. The stake is bonded to a unique, non-transferable identity credential, a relic of past verified work, so a fresh fake cannot copy it. Peers audit each other's proofs, and a single lantern of honest attestation can expose a whole fake cluster; when fraud is found the stake is slashed, so an attacker loses real money for every clone they spin up, while honest agents keep earning.
